========================================================================================================
                  TARE METROLOGY REFERENCE: COST PER SUCCESSFUL TASK & PARETO GATING                    
========================================================================================================
Scenario                               Quality   Tokens/Req   Cost/Call   Cost/Success (CPST)   p95 Latency   Verdict
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. Baseline Production Agent            80.0%       1,850      $0.0360          $0.0450           1,840ms     [BASELINE]
2. Prompt Cache & Context Prune         80.0%         980      $0.0210          $0.0264 (-41%)    1,120ms     [SHIP: Quality-Flat Efficiency Win]
3. Cheap Model Swap (Vanity Trap)       32.0%       1,650      $0.0200 (-44%)   $0.0625 (+39%)    4,200ms     [BLOCKED: Vanity Call Cost Trap]
4. Pareto Breakthrough Model            90.0%       1,200      $0.0270          $0.0300 (-33%)    1,280ms     [SHIP: Pareto Dominant Win]
5. Unbounded Reasoning Loop             81.0%       4,800      $0.0910          $0.1123 (+150%)   6,800ms     [BLOCKED: Latency SLA Breach]
========================================================================================================
Key Ground Truth:
  - Tracking cost per call hides failure rate and retry blowup.
  - Cost Per Successful Task (CPST) = Gross Task Spend / Total Tasks Passed.
  - A change that keeps quality flat while cutting CPST 40% is a high-impact win that deserves to ship.
